validation_rules: immutable snapshots and index hash validation
latest failed attempt blocks old success

manifest.json carries a required metrics member that must satisfy evidence-index-metrics.schema.json; an attempt is accepted only after evidence_store.check_metrics passes: metrics_sha256 equals the sha256 of the member's canonical bytes, and its source_fingerprint, indexed file count, exclusion count and file_set_sha256 agree with manifest.json and the files table of index.sqlite

metrics are descriptive only: aggregate file, byte, line and blank-line counts by closed scope, closed language label and content kind; they are not evidence of coverage, quality, reachability or analysis and cannot support or promote any claim class, finding or severity

metrics cover exactly the indexed files, each counted once: unknown file types are counted as unclassified; binary and non-UTF-8 files are counted as files and bytes with null line counts; vendored, generated and review-evidence scope is labelled, never dropped

metrics publish no per-file path, name or content, no comment/code split, and no timestamp, host path or tool version; an identical snapshot yields a byte-identical canonical metrics member, and so an identical metrics_sha256, under the same rules_version
a consumer that relies on metrics re-derives them with evidence_store.check_metrics(attempt, True) from index.sqlite and objects/; the published member is a cache, never an authority
